units.source_text: 众侍女虽然不曾公然把信打开来看，但隐约察知这是紫夫人的遗迹，大家觉得无限悲伤。

en.t: Although the ladies-in-waiting had not openly opened the letters to read them, they dimly realized that these were relics left by Lady Murasaki, and they all felt boundless sorrow.

units.source_text: 当时紫夫人和他同生在这世间，两人相离不远，而写来的信如此哀伤。

en.t: At that time Lady Murasaki was still living in this world together with him, and the two were not far apart, yet the letters she had written were so mournful.

units.source_text: 源氏今日再看这些信，自比当时更加悲痛，那眼泪竟无法收住了。

en.t: When Genji looked at these letters again today, he felt even more grief than he had then, and his tears could no longer be held back.

units.source_text: 但念悲痛过甚，深恐旁人笑他儿女之态，因此并不细看，但在一封长信的一端题诗一首：

en.t: But thinking that his sorrow was too excessive, and deeply fearing that others would laugh at such a tender, womanish display, he did not read them closely, but wrote a poem at one end of a long letter:
